title: Deadlock between PilelineHashMapRD::local_mutex and GDScriptCache::mutex
body:
### Tested versions

master(commit b5bdb88062a31a982c8f3bf4b820188edd53c6c5)
Godot 4.4 release
and highly likely some previous versions of 4.4

### System information

Windows 10, CPU AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor, GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti

### Issue description

Godot freezes on loading resources. I'm not able to produce an MRP, but I think I found the cause of the deadlock.

### Steps to reproduce

In debugger there is a two important threads. Here are theirs callstacks:

Thread 16964 locks GDScriptCache::mutex in function GDScriptCache::get_full_script and waits on PipelineHashMapRD<...>::local_mutex in function PipelineHashMapRD<...>::compile_pipeline. Other thread locks PipelineHashMapRD<...>::local_mutex in function PipelineHashMapRD<...>::wait_for_pipeline and wait GDScriptCache::mutex in function WorkerThreadPool::_lock_unlockable_mutexes. One of mutexes in 'unlockable_locks' is actually a GDScriptCache::mutex.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I'm not able to make MRP, I will make PR for this issue.
